(201)༄༅/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lam gyi rim pa'i mngon rtogs dbang bskur thugs rje chen po'i chu rgyun bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (201)༄༅// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lam gyi rim pa'i mngon rtogs dbang bskur thugs rje chen po'i chu rgyun bzhugs so//

(202)༄༅// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren pa mchog gi gtso// skye med chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos par// sprul pa du mas 'gro kun 'dren mdzad pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang de la phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid ji ltar dbang bskur bya ba'i tshul// snyan brgyud dbang gi chu rgyun ma chad pa// ji ltar bla ma'i zhal gyi pad+mo las// byung ba 'di ni bdag gis bkod par bgyi// 'dir spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba la don gnyis te/ lha sgrub cing mchod pa dang dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gnyis te/ bkod pa bshams pa/ mngon rtogs bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs 'khor yug dang bcas pa bris pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i lte ba dkar/ 'dab ma bzhi phyogs mdog /mtshams bzhi mdzes tshon bya/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba'i tshon 'gyed/ tha ma phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ mchod gtor rnams kyis bskor/ dbang bum dang las bum gnyis/ kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa bshams/ ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba sin+dhu ras (203)byugs pa la/ dbus su hrīḥbaṃ gnyis bri/ 'dab ma bzhi ha ri ni sa bris nas bshams/ rdo rje dril bu la sogs dbang rdzas rnams kyang sta gon bya'o// gnyis pa mngon rtogs sgom pa la gsum ste/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed do// dang po bdag bskyed la gsum/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byang*/ yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa/ bskyed rim bsgom zhing bzlas pa bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag gzhan pha ma sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'chi'o// chos la skyabs su 'chi'o// dge 'dun la skyabs su 'chi'o// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su 'chi'o// zhes lan gsum bya/

de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i thog mar/ yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs su gyur ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas spyan ras gzigs la rgyal ba sras (204)bcas kyi bskor ba spyan drangs/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ swā hā/ dkon gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa'i tshogs kyis mchod par bgyi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge bas byang chub mchog thob shog / ces dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rdo rje gur las byung ba bzhin lan gsum bya/ de nas tshogs zhing mi dmigs/ gsum pa ni/ thog mar tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par 'gyur cig / ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ de nas mngon byang lngas bskyed rim bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swā bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong zhing bdag med par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lnga'i steng du ri bo mchog rab kyi steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan gyi steng du sna tshogs rdo rje las 'od 'phros/ srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs por gyur ba'i dbus su bhūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan 'od du zhu ba las/ gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsigs pa rim pa lnga las/ rta babs bzhi tog dang bcas pa/ rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ baṃ yig dmar po las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas jo bo spyan ras gzigs (205)kyi sar bkod/

'od zer tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma'i sdong po dkar po/ lte ba hrīḥdang baṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par spyan drangs pad+ma hrīḥdang baṃ la thim yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha'i dar sna tshogs kyis stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang*/ nor bu'i ske rags grol thabs su 'ching bu/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po 'dzin pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i yu ba nas 'dzin cing rab rgyas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa/ spyan dkyus dang smin dkyus ring ba mdzod spu dkar pos brgyan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan nag po gyen la bcings shing ral pa'i zar bu rked sor g.yogs pa me tog gi phreng bas skra chings can/ ut+pal sngon po gnyis kyis snyan gong brgyan pa/ ri dwags lpags pas phrag pa g.yon pa bkab pa/ rin po che sna lngas rtse phran lnga dang*/ snyan cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ do shal dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ 'og pag dang*/ mu tig sna lngas chun po dang*/ dar gyi cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer sna la 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum gsang ba ye shes sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar (206)dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked pa la 'khril ba/ phyag g.yas pas gser gyi ḍā ma ru nam mkhar 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas ka pā la bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun gyis bkang nas yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing cung zad bzhad pa/ khro 'dzum spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog dang zar bu rked sor g.yogs pas/

thod skam rin po che'i rtse phran gyis mtshan pa lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ dkar 'dzin dang chu 'dzin rgyas pa/ zhi ba 'dzum pa/ gzhon cing sgeg pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba'o// de'i gnas lngar pad zla'i steng du spyi bor oṃ las rnam snang spyan ras gzigs yab yum dkar po/ mgrin par hrī las pad+ma spyan ras gzigs yab yum dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs yab yum sngon po/ lte bar trāṃ las rin 'byung spyan ras gzigs yab yum ser po/ gsang gnas su āḥlas don grub spyan ras gzigs yab yum ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang gtso bo'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa/ de'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi cung zad tsam gtsigs pa/ g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag /gru khug tu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zhabs gnyis g.yon brkyang g.yas bskum pa'i gar gyis/ me ri'i klong na bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs (207)pa'o// de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥ dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med gcig tu gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes rigs lngas dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus kyi nang gang*/ lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las tshe dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ rang gi snying gar pad zla'i steng du/

rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba'i thugs kar hrīḥganas pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad spyan ras gzigs rigs lnga zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pas gang*/ phyir 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi skur gyur/ thams cad zhal nas gsang sngags 'dren par bsams la/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes ma yengs pa'i sems kyis 'dren no// mthar/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bden pas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab bo// 'di ni bsnyen pa bya ba ste/ dus zla ba gsum/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa bye ba gsum/ mtshan ma'i rtags rab mngon sum du spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi zhal mthong ba dang*/ lung ston pa 'byung*/ 'bring nyams snang*/ tha ma rmi lam du mi dkar po dang*/ bud med dmar mos dngos grub ster ba dang*/ khro ma 'du ba la sogs pa'i (208)rtags 'byung ngo*// ༈ gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ rdul tshon nam/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs lnga'i steng du ri bo mchog rab/ ces pa nas sngags 'dren pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar du bsgom bzlas bya'o// gsum pa bum bskyed ni/ rnal rgyal bum dang las bum gnyis/ snying po bzhugs pa/ mgul chings kha rgyan rnams tshul bzhin bshams la/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bskrad/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i bum pa zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgul pa ring ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i dar gyis mgul pa dkris pa/

dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa'i nang du 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las skyes pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdang baṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ gzhal du med pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi sar bkod/ 'od zer de tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma'i sdong po dkar po lte bar hrīḥdang baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ zhes pa nas/ zhal nas sngags 'dren par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar bdag skyed ltar bskyed la/ rang gi snying khar zhes pa'i skabs su/ bum skyed kyi lha'i khar zhes 'don pa dang dmigs pa bsgyur/ thams cad zhal nas sngags 'dren par bsam zhing*/ zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren/ oṃ badz+ra ut+ta ka swā hā/ zhes pa yang brgya 'dren no// mthar/ jo mo spyan ras gzigs/ ces pa nas/ mdzad du gsol/ zhes (209)gsol ba gdab bo// de nas/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// spyan ras gzigs su mtshan gsol ba// rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ las bum/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛ ta ces sogs kyis bsangs/ swā bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pad+ma'i dbyug to/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stag lpags kyis sham thabs can/ khro zhal spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/

dbu skra ngan ra ser gyen la brdzes pa/ spyi bor rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad phyogs bcur sgrogs pa/ rngog ma dmar po me ltar 'bar ba/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ mthing ga las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho ཿsa dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ rigs lngas dbang bskur/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan (210)thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥ'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam la/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad 'dren/ mchod mthar mchod nas/ ma chags pad+ma rigs kyi rnam 'phrul las// klu rgyal tshul gyis gdug pa kun 'dul ba// dbang chen bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// khro rgyal rta mgrin mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod do// de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo// ༈ gnyis pa dbang bskur la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa/ dbang bzhi bskur ba/ mjug rjes gnang sbyin pa'o// dang po sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa la don bcu gsum ste/ gsol ba btab pa/ sdom pa bzung ba/ mig dar bcings pa/ me tog sbyin pa/ bsrung bar bya ba/ sems skyed pa/ phyag bya ba/ dam la bzhag pa/ ye shes phab cing gnang ba dri ba dang*/ me tog dor bar dang*/ spyan dbye ba dang*/ lha ngo bstan pa dang*/ ched du brjod pa'o// dang po ni slob ma rnams khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol//

ces sogs/ gnyis pa ni/ dang po thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// ces thun mong gi sdom pa bzung*/ de nas khyad par sdom pa bzung ba ni/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs rnams// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// ji (211)ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsam ste bzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'gro kun mya ngan 'das la 'god//

ces lan gsum brjod la sdom pa bzung ngo*// gsum pa ni mig dar bcings la/ oṃ tsak+ṣu ban+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ bzhi pa me tog phreng ba gtad la/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ swā hā/ lnga pa (212)bsrung bar bya ba ni/ rta mgrin gyi snying pos bsangs la/ rang nyid skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs su mos pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dris thig le bya/ drug pa ni/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba zhig bsgom la/ ngag tu/ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga tsit+ta u pa ta yā mi/ zhes brjod do// rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzung ste/ oṃ su ra te sa ma yas+t+waṃ ho/ sid+dha badz+ra ya wā su khaṃ/ zhes pa brjod do// bdun pa phyag byar ni/ khro bo rta mgrin gyis khrid nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du khrid par mos te/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ oṃ na mo te hūm̐/ oṃ na mo me hūm̐/ na mo na ma hūm̐/ oṃ na mo lo ke shwa ra yā/ zhes phyag bya'o// brgyad pa dam la bzhag pa la bzhi/ dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de na sangs khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyi dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes so// gnyis pa gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ de ring spyan ras gzigs dbang rang*// khyod kyis snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems// zhes brjod/ gsum pa nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/

dam tshig gi chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig (213)bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha// zhes chu blud do// bzhi pa slob dpon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi ni// spyan ras gzigs dbang nga yin gyi// nga yi 'di gyis gang bsgo ba// khyod kyis kyang ni bya dgos so// zhes dam tshig bsgrag go /dgu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyi brlab tu gsol/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag la dbab par gyur cig / ces brjod nas/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i snang ba mtha' yas su bsgoms pa'i rkang zhabs su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ba dan g.yo ba yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ dzhaiḥdzhaiḥdamar po gnyis gnyis kyis 'degs pa/ sum mdor raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dang me 'bar bas mtshan pa/ snying gar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa rdo rjes mtshan par nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor bum pa zla ba la āḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ mgor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla ba la haṃ dkar pos mtshan pa/ rkang zhabs kyi dzhaiḥgyi 'od zer rkang pa'i rtsa bo che nas zhugs/ sum mdor me dang 'dres nas cher 'bar/ snying ga'i sa'i dkyil 'khor dmar lam lam par bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar bun bun par bskol/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ hūm̐ haṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ba spu'i rtse nas phyir 'phros pas/ spyan ras gzigs dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs nas mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par bsgom la/ gu gul dang spos kyis 'dug / oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā (214)ki ni ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ a be sha ya/ staṃ bha ya/

ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya/ tsa la ya/ hūm̐ hāḥ a ཿdzhaiḥ zhes ye shes gdab bo// de nas dkyil 'khor kha dog 'dri zhing*/ las bzhi grub par lung bstan no// bcu pa ni/ de nas me tog phreng ba traṃ gyis sngags pa gsar zhing ma rnying pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'od gsal bar byas/ spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi dbu la dor bar mos la/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug pa 'di// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa 'di// bsod nams ji ltar de ltar zhog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra bar// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐ pra tīts+tsha ku su māñca liṃ nā tha hoḥ zhes me tog gtor/ slar pra ti grih+ṇa daṃ i maṃ sa twa hā ba la/ zhes me tog phreng ba mgo la bcing ngo*// bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ oṃ de ring spyan ras gzigs dbang rang*// khyod kyi mig ni phye bar brtson// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// thams cad mig ni 'byed par mdzad// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ bcu gnyis pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ kye rdo rje ltos shig / ces brjod nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi lha ngo bstan pas mthong bar mos te/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyi// thabs dang shes rab dang ldan pas// gsang sngags rnams la bsgrub par gyis// zhes brjod cing*/ bcu gsum pa ched du brjod pa ni/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// (215)rnal 'byor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong ngo*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// zhes ched du brjod par bya'o//

༈ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la bzhi ste/ bum dbang dang*/ gsang dbang dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rang don sgrub pa rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang*/ gzhan don sgrub pa rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang ngo*// dang po la lnga ste/ mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang dang*/ don yon grub pa dril bu'i dbang dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang ngo*// ༈ dang po la mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang la gnyis te gsol ba gdab pa dang dbang bskur ba dngos so// dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyabs pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ rta mgrin gyi sngags/ las bum gyi chus dbang rdzas dang slob pa rnams bsang la/ slob dpon dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum/ swā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis skyil krung can/ de'i pang na yum gsang ba ye shes sngon mo/ rdo rje dang bum pa 'dzin pas yab la sbyor ba/ yab yum gnyis ka yang mtshan dpe'i 'od dang ldan zhing*/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i spyi mgrin snying khar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ slar 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams (216)kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rdo rje'i sgeg ma rnams kyis glu len zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis me tog mngon par gtor zhing bkra shis brjod par

bsam la/ sangs rgyas rab bdun pa'am/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis brjod/ de nas dbang bum gyis spyi bo nas dbang bskur ro// rdo rje dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyis bum pa'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga la u da ka a bhi ṣiñca maṃ zhes dbang bskur/ slar spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo bum pa 'dzin pa zhig chad nas/ bum chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ badz+ra ḍā ki ni a bhi ṣiñcha maṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis// bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyis phyag byas rigs kun gyi ni bdag ni bdag po mchog /sems can thams cad bskyed mdzad bde ba chen po ster// deng 'dir dbang bskur mchog thob khyed la bkra shis shog / ces bkra shis brjod/ sgeg mo rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba badz+ra su sang gra he/ badz+ra ma nut+ta ra ni/ badz+ra dharmā kā ya ni/ badz+ra karma ka rod bha we/ zhes rdo rje'i glu blangs/ khro bo rnams kyis// oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bgegs bskrad/ gu gul la sogs me tog gi char phab/ rnga bo che la sogs pa rol mo'i sgra bsgrag / bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pas lus kyi nang gang*/ lhag ma yar 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan cing khyed rang rnams mi bskyod pa spyan (217)ras gzigs kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par/ bsam la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rol mo bya/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ pād+yaṃ= badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe= badz+ra ā lo ke= badz+ra gan+dhe= badz+ra nai wi te=

badz+ra shap+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod/ des mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang*/ rnam par shes pa'i phung por gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du gyur snyam du mos par mdzod/ ces dbang gi rtogs pa brjod/ ༈ gnyis pa rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur gnyis/ gsol ba 'debs pa dang dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ rin chen rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// rin chen rdo rje deng bdag stsal// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs yab yum bskyed pa'i gnas gsum gyi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med du gyur/ de nyid 'od du zhu ba las rin po che'i dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur ba ni/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyis dbu rgyan dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mu ku ṭa abhi ṣiñca hūm̐ su ra ti taṃ a haṃ/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes dbang bskur/ slar mdun skyed spyan ras gzigs yab yum (218)gyi lte ba nas/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo dbang bum 'dzin pa zhig chad nas/ bum chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ rat+na ḍā ki ni a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ snga mar ltar/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sgeg mos glu blangs/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ me tog gi char phab/

rol mo'i sgra bsgrag /dbang gi chus lus kyi nang gang*/ lhag ma yar 'khyil pa la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod// des rin chen 'byung ldan dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa ser sna dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas pa'o// zhes dbang gis rtogs pa brjod pa'o// ༈ gsum pa snang ba mtha' yas rdo rjes dbang skur la gnyis/ dang po gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ pad+ma can gyi sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// pad+ma rdo rje deng bdag stsol// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas stong pa'i ngang las/ dziṃ las pad+ma dziṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs yab yum du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ rigs lnga nas dbang rdzas snang ba mtha' yas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba rdo rje'i dbang bskur bar bsam la/ pad+ma'i dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ ma hā badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ slar mdun bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dbang bum 'dzin pa zhig chad nas/ bum chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ pad+ma ḍā (219)ki ni a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bos bgegs bskrad/ mchod pas mchod pa gong dang 'dra/ rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ des snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes mngon du byas// snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas/

zhes rtogs pa'i brjod do// ༈ bzhi don yod grub pa dril bus dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dang po gsol gdab pa ni/ las kyi rigs mchog sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// las kyi rdo rje deng bdag stsol// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas stong pa'i ngang las/ khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs yab yum du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ slar dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ don yod grub 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ las kyi dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas// sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu'i dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ badz+ra a dhī pa ti staṃ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ā aḥ zhes dbang bskur/ slar mdun skyed kyi gsang ba'i spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi thugs ka nas/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu dbang bum 'dzin pa zhig chad nas bum chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ (220)karma ḍā ki ni a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ bkra shis

sogs gong dang 'dra/ rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ des don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag /'du byed phung po gnas gyur// bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ don yod grub pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byas pa'o// zhes rtogs brjod do// ༈ lnga pa rnam par snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs ming gis dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// byang chub rdo rje deng bdag stsol// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni slob ma dang dbang rdzas/ swabhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs yab yum du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ rigs lnga'i 'khor bcas kyis ming gis dbang bskur bar bsam la/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi ming gi dbang// deng 'dir khyod la bskul bar bya// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ zhes pad+ma'i rdo rje la sogs kyi mthar/ sngags kyang brjod do// slar mdun bskyed kyi spyi bo'i rnam snang spyan ras gzigs yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo dbang bum 'dzin pa zhig chad nas bum chus dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ pa ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ bud+dha ḍā ki ni a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ bkra shis sogs gong dang 'dra/ rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ des rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /(221)gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang mngon du byas pa'o// zhes rtogs pa brjod do//

de dag gis ma rig pa'i gnyen po rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pa'o// ༈ gnyis pa gzhan don byed pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la gnyis/ dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gis bdag ni khyod drin las// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma dang dbang rdzas/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis skyil krung can/ yum rdo rje snyems ma rdor dril 'dzin pa dang mnyam pa sbyar ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog /mdun bskyed kyi sku gcig la mar me stong chad pa'i rnam par/ sku gcig la sku'i tshogs dpag tu med pa chad nas slob ma'i lus la thim par bsam la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod do// rol mo bya/ spyan ras gzigs kyi skus spyi bor dbang bskur zhing*/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sku yi dbang*// deng 'dir khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// spyan ras gzigs su khyod gyur cig / ces bya'o// slar thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lnga 'khor bcas kyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ lag pa gnyis su rdo rje dril bu gtad do// rdo rje tshe dang dril bu che// (222)zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba gnyis du gyis// zhes brjod do// des nas bum chus dbang bskur ba ni/ gsang gsum dam tshig las byung ba// ye shes bdud rtsi dri ma med// lha yi chu ni dag pa yi// dag pa bzang pos dbang bskur ro// oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/

de nas me tog gtor la/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur ro// ces brjod do// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ sngags phreng bla ma spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal nas slob ma'i zhal du zhugs nas/ snying ga'i hrīḥl thim par bsam/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ shel phreng spyi bor bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod do// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal me long g.ya' dag pa lta bu rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs thams cad dang bral ba/ gsal stong so so rang rig pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ me long bstan la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cig gsal la rnyogs pa med// rgyu dang las la yang dag 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes brjod do// de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi las phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor/ bla ma bzhi las sprul sku'i bla ma la/ dbang bzhi las bum pa'i dbang thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las gtso chen lus kyi sgrib pa dag /rim pa bzhi las bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skye/ 'bras bu bzhi (223)las sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku rdo rje'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// zhes dbang gi rtogs pa brjod do// ༈ gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gzhon nu ma dam tshig dang ldan pa bla ma la phul la/ mig dar bcings/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// zhes sogs/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yab yum snyoms par 'jug par mos la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes bla ma yab yum gyi bde ba chen po'i sgra dang snying kha'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum rang gi spyi bor byon/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ bla ma'i spyi bo nas thim/ a wa dhu ti'i lam brgyud/ thabs kyi rdo rje nas 'thon/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i byang sems slob ma'i khar blugs pa mos shing*/ zhes ka pā la'i bdud rtsi slob ma'i khar blud cing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// bu khyod la ni dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñca āḥ ces brjod la byang sems sbyin no// slob mas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i blos/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes btung bas/ ngag nas brgyud de bde ba chen pos rang gi rgyud yongs su gang bar sgoms shig / ces brjod/ mig dar bsal/ des kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma bzhi las longs spyod rdzogs sku'i bla ma la/ dbang bzhi las gsang (224)dbang thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las gnas skabs su ngag gi sgrib pa dag /rim pa bzhi las rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las mchog dga'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'bras bu bzhi las gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i skal pa can du byas// zhes rtogs pa brjod pa'o// ༈ gsum pa shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ mig dar/ shes rab ma nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa bla ma la 'bul bar mos shing*/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ zhes pa nas/ shes rab ye shes dbang bskur stsol// zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ bla mas rig ma mtshan bzang dang ldan pa rgyan thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa zhig byin par mos la/

gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bstan byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba chen por spyod par gyis// lha mo de nyid kyis dri zhim pa'i chu skyes mngon par ston bzhin pas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun du nang gnas te// sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa// bya ba ji bzhin pad+mas byed// bde chen rgyal po nga nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// bha dza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs par bsam/ de nas slob hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar nas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi nor bu'i phreng ba dang pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis mngon par brgyan pa bskyed do// rig (225)ma de nyid baṃ las mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes sku mdog byi ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing bde ba chen pos rgyud yongs su gang ba/ phyag g.yas gser gyi ḍā ma ru nam mkhar 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon bdud rtsi dmar pos bkang ba'i thod pa yab kyi zhal du stob pa/ zhabs gnyis yab kyi rked par 'khril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan par bskyed pa'i yab yum gnyis kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar swā/ gsang bar hā/ yab kyi gsang ba mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nor bu'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ phyag rgya'i gsang ba mi dmigs pa las āḥlas skyes pa'i chu bskyed dmar po ze'u 'bru āḥdamar pos mtshan par bsgom la/ yab yum snyoms par 'jug pas/ oṃ shri shri shri ha ha ha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bde ba chen po'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yab yum thams cad bskul nas/

rang gi spyi bor byon nas snyoms 'jug mdzad// chags pa chen pos 'od du zhu nas/ spyi bo'i haṃ gi byang sems dang dbyer med par spyi bo nas mgrin par babs/ dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ mgrin pa nas snying khar babs/ mchog dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ snying kha nas lte bar babs/ khyad dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ lte ba nas gsang bar babs/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsgom/ de nas hūm̐ zhes 'og rlung steng du drangs pas/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du gyur par bsgom la/ lhan skyes bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i (226)ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag gi dkyil 'khor bzhi las yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma bzhi las chos sku'i bla ma la/ dbang bzhi las shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las gtso bor yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam rim pa bzhi las don dam 'od gsal gyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las khyad par dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu bzhi las thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku'i go 'phang mngon du byas pa'o// zhes rtogs pa brjod do// ༈ bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che bskur ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cig /bdag nyid tshe khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ gdong g.yogs bcings/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ 'di skad brjod do// chos thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rang bzhin/ yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i bdag nyid/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi thabs// zhes gsungs pa dang*/

bzhi pa yang ni de de bzhin no// ces gsum pa dpe dang*/ bzhi pa don du bstan pa dang*/ gsum pa rgyu dang*/ bzhi pa 'bras bu bstan pa dang*/ gsum pa myu gu lta bu/ bzhi pa 'bras bu lta bur bstan pa/ yan lag bdun ldan phyag rgya chen po'i don bshad la ngo sprad par bya'o// de nas gdong g.yogs bsal/ des dkyil 'khor bzhi las don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ bla ma bzhi las (227)ngo bo nyid sku'i bla ma las/ dbang bzhi las tshig dbang rin po che thob/ sgrib pa bzhi las lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag /rim pa bzhi las zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'bras bu bzhi las ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byas pa'i skal pa can du byas so// zhes rtogs pa brjod/ 'di nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gtso che bas 'di dag 'grub bo// gal te rgyas par spro na/ gsum pa mjug rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ brtul zhugs sbyin pa/ gzhan don chos 'chad/ lung bstan dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod pa rnams byas kyang 'gal ba med do// bdag 'jug kyang cho ga rim 'di nyid kyis len par bya'o// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ deng nas bzung ste khyod bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi// khyod kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod do// de dag gis dbang bskur bar song ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa dang bstod pa bya/ tshogs la rol zhing lhag gtor btang*/ bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pas kha skang*/ bsngo ba smon lam bya/ ye shes pa brten la bstim/ dam tshig rang la bstim/ dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab/ bkra shis brjod/ rdul tshon rol mo dang bcas pas 'bab chu'i gzhung la dor/ las kyi mtha' mi mngon par bya'o// de dag gis rjes kyi rim pa song ngo*//

༈ spyan ras gzigs mgon byin rlabs chu gter las// bla med rgyud kyi dbang bzhi'i chu klung 'bab// 'gro kun gnas skabs dri ma bzhi dag nas// dga' bzhi sku bzhi'i rgya mtsho rgyas gyur cig /'di ni khrid zhu ba'i thog mar ma gtogs pa/ dam tshig mi bsrung ba'i mi dang*/ gang byung du dbang bskur 'di byas na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung bas mi bya'o// dbang zhus nas dam tshig bsrung na mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par (228)shes par bya'o// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mngon dkyil thugs rje chen po'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpal ldan bla ma'i man ngag bzhin rgyud sde'i cho ga dang rjes mthun par/ rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rje zhes bya bas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i ri bo po ta lar bkod pa'o// 'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig// /dge legs 'phel/
